_comment: Every sentence the desktop app says before the engine serves a page, plus its native dialogs. The app's Rust reads it with serde_json, the install screen reads it with fetch, and the pytest hold reads it with json.loads, so the three cannot drift. A stop on the install screen is newline-separated parts: what happened, what to do next, and, where there is one, the line Details shows. A part whose slot has nothing to fill is not drawn.
gate_lede: Set up RadialRig to manage your agents' project documents, along with the tools it needs.
gate_reassure: Your own files stay untouched, and you can remove all of it from this app later.
gate_press_note: Nothing runs until you choose Install RadialRig.
working_lede: RadialRig is installing the tools it needs.
progress_probe: Checking the tools already on this computer.

progress_extract.windows: Putting the tools in your user folder.
progress_extract.linux: Putting the tools in your user folder.

progress_path.windows: Adding the programs folder to your user Path.
progress_path.linux: Checking whether the programs folder is on your PATH.

fail_checksum:
The download failed its check.
Install a newer version of the RadialRig app to get the corrected download.
The support tools download did not match what this app expected.
fail_path_write:
Couldn't update your user Path.
Nothing after this step ran, and RadialRig isn't installed yet. Try again.
fail_package_checksum:
The RadialRig download failed its check.
Install a newer version of the RadialRig app to get the corrected download.
The RadialRig package download did not match what this app expected.
recovery_held:
Another program is using RadialRig.
Try again, and RadialRig will try to stop the programs listed in Details before each attempt to replace the engine.

fail_foreign_exe.windows:
Another radialrig.exe is already installed.
Move or delete {detail}, then reopen RadialRig.
fail_foreign_exe.linux:
Another radialrig command is already installed.
Move or delete {detail}, then reopen RadialRig.

fail_engine_old:
An older RadialRig engine is installed.
This computer has version {detail}, and this app needs {needed} or newer. Choose Try again and this app replaces it; programs that use RadialRig lose it for a moment and may need to reconnect.
fail_engine_unread:
Couldn't read the installed RadialRig version.
This app needs version {needed} or newer. Choose Try again and this app replaces it; programs that use RadialRig lose it for a moment and may need to reconnect.
fail_picker_no_target: This screen doesn't have a project folder field. Folder you chose: {detail}
fail_debug_override: Debug build using custom package source: {detail}
path_report_on: Your PATH already includes {detail}. RadialRig left your PATH as it is.
path_report_off: Your PATH doesn't include {detail}. RadialRig left your PATH as it is.
swap_running:
Replacing an older version
RadialRig is replacing the older engine so this app can start. Programs that use RadialRig lose it for a moment and may need to reconnect. Keep this window open until it finishes.
swap_held_none: No RadialRig program was found running. Another program may still have a file open in RadialRig's folder.
update_ready:
RadialRig {detail} is available. You have {current}.
Updating closes RadialRig, installs the new version, and reopens it.
update_failed_download:
The update wasn't installed, and nothing changed.
The download didn't finish. Check your internet connection or try again later.
update_failed_signature:
The update wasn't installed, and nothing changed.
The download failed its signature check, so RadialRig didn't run it.
update_failed_version:
The update wasn't installed, and nothing changed.
The download was signed for a different version than expected, so RadialRig didn't run it.
update_failed_install:
The update wasn't installed.
The download passed its check, but RadialRig couldn't install it.
uninstall_notice: This uninstalls the RadialRig desktop app and its own files. It doesn't remove the engine, uv, the Python uv installed for it, RadialRig's files in your projects, or your client entries. If you followed the steps in Remove RadialRig before this, this was the last one. Otherwise, run {detail} manage and open Remove RadialRig to remove the rest.
uninstall_path_removed: Removed the entry RadialRig added to your user Path. The rest of your Path is unchanged.
uninstall_path_kept: Left your user Path unchanged because it was edited after RadialRig added its entry. Removing it automatically could overwrite those edits. The entry is {detail}, under HKCU\Environment.
uninstall_path_gone: The entry RadialRig added wasn't on your user Path, so your Path was left unchanged.
uninstall_path_absent: No Path change record was found, so your user Path was left unchanged.
uninstall_path_error: Couldn't read your user Path, so it was left unchanged.
uninstall_path_write_error: Couldn't update your user Path, so it was left unchanged. The entry RadialRig added is still there: {detail}, under HKCU\Environment.
